title: card_drift.mjs's closure carries plan_view.py's 106 files, 11 cell files among them, though it renders both sides from one payload and cannot see a payload change
claim: tests/closure.py folds the PRODUCERS edge into card_drift.mjs's closure, so every change to any of plan_view.py's 106 closure files (11 of the 12 D3-s1 cell files among them) selects card_drift.mjs. card_drift renders the working tree's card and the ref's card against the same plan payload, so a change that only moves the payload cannot move a state: 8 of 8 cell mutants that changed the payload plan_view.py writes left card_drift 'identical in all 45 states' (rc 0). The positive control, one edit to the card source, turned it red.
mechanism: tests/closure.py merge: `for consumer, producers in PRODUCERS.items(): closures[consumer] |= closures[prod]`, justified as 'anything that can change the payload can change what they test'. That holds for tests/card.mjs, which asserts what the markup contains. It does not hold for tests/card_drift.mjs, whose own header says both sides run 'against the same plan payload and the same frozen clock'; PRODUCERS's own comment says the same. The producer edge is needed for ordering (plan_view.py must run first), not for membership.

evidence.unit: card_drift.mjs red runs over 8 cell-file mutants that each changed the plan_view.py payload's sha256 (115 inventory sites scanned in file order)
evidence.machine: owner macOS arm64 (Darwin, 8 cores), venv-ci CPython 3.14, node
evidence.contention_note: Counts are contention-immune. Run 2026-11-17T19:47-20:00Z with load1 about 217 (other seats on the machine). card_drift's recorded cost is 6.0 s in tests/closures.json; measured here 14.1 s wall (provisional).
evidence.closure_counts: closures.json: card_drift.mjs 118 files = plan_view.py's 106 + 12 of its own (card source, card_rig.mjs, dom_stub.mjs, the card claim file, VERSION, .gitignore, ...)

instrumented_symbol: tests/closure.py PRODUCERS fold (tests/closures.json closures['tests/card_drift.mjs']); tests/card_drift.mjs verdict line; the payload tests/plan_view.py writes (HPO_PLANDATA)

perturbation.change: Positive control: edit the card source custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js line 75, the default title 'Heat pump plan' -> 'Heat-pump plan'
perturbation.observed_value: card_drift rc 0 -> 1 (states moved), against rc 0 for all 8 payload-moving cell mutants

metric_definition: Of K cell-file inventory mutants (tests/mutation_table.py inventory, lines plan_view.py's traced baseline executes) that change the sha256 of the payload plan_view.py writes, the number for which `node tests/card_drift.mjs HEAD^1` exits non-zero.
phenomenon_property: A differential consumer that feeds both of its sides the same producer output is closed over its producer's files, so every producer-only change selects a script that by construction cannot fail on it.

null_control.value: unmutated tree: payload f769f5bd7cd3, card_drift rc 0 'identical in all 45 states'
null_control.note: The null control and the positive control run in the same harness invocation and the same worker tree; the positive control shows card_drift can fail in this rig, so 0 of 8 is blindness, not a broken harness.

proposed_fix_scope: tests/closure.py: keep card_drift.mjs's PRODUCERS edge for ordering (suite_order, selection of the producer) but stop folding the producer's closure into card_drift.mjs's membership; card.mjs keeps the fold. Re-derive closures on Linux; a guard pins that a payload-only change does not select card_drift.mjs.
